title: Bridging Human and Model Attention: Explainability Analysis of CNN, Mamba, and ViT Architectures with Gaze-Based Validation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12703v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-risk applications of deep learning require precise characterization of model decision-making. We conduct a systematic explainability evaluation across Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Vision Transformers (ViTs), and Vision Mamba (ViM). Unlike predominantly qualitative studies, we quantify the alignment between model attention and human visual perception using eye-tracking ground truth. We formalize this comparison via a standardized normalization pipeline mapping post-hoc attribution maps and gaze heatmaps onto spatial probability distributions. Alignment is evaluated across fine-grained classification, medical imaging, and emotion recognition using architecture-specific XAI methods. We measure fidelity using Jensen-Shannon similarity, Chi-square similarity, and Pearson correlation, three complementary estimators capturing support overlap, mass discrepancy, and structural co-variation. translated_title: 桥接人类与模型注意力：基于眼动注视验证的CNN、Mamba与ViT架构可解释性分析
translated_abstract: 深度学习在高风险应用场景中需要对模型决策过程进行精确刻画。我们对卷积神经网络（CNN）、视觉Transformer（ViT）以及视觉Mamba（ViM）进行了系统性的可解释性评估。与以往以定性分析为主的研究不同，我们利用眼动追踪数据作为真值基准，量化了模型注意力与人类视觉感知之间的对齐程度。我们通过一个标准化的归一化流程将这一比较形式化，该流程将事后归因图和注视热图映射到空间概率分布上。我们采用针对各架构定制的XAI方法，在细粒度分类、医学影像和情绪识别任务上评估对齐程度。我们使用Jensen-Shannon相似度、卡方相似度和Pearson相关系数这三种互补的估计量来衡量保真度，它们分别捕捉支持域重叠、质量差异和结构共变关系。我们的结果揭示了各架构独特的注意力动态特征（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献是首次以眼动追踪数据为真值，通过标准化归一化流程和三种互补的相似度指标，系统量化了CNN、ViT和Vision Mamba三种架构的模型注意力与人类视觉注意力在多个视觉任务上的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically quantifies the alignment between model attention of CNN, ViT, and Vision Mamba architectures and human visual attention, using eye-tracking ground truth, a standardized normalization pipeline, and three complementary similarity metrics across multiple vision tasks.
